postgres_wait_sampling.scope: Sample counts of backends, not exact query wait durations; idle ClientRead is not blocking work; CPU_or_runnable is not measured CPU; sampler connection excluded

instrumentation_scope: Constant-space aggregate histograms; phase times overlap across concurrent work; CPU separate for driver/crypto/API; no request or SQL text
scheduler: 50 independent ordered conversation lanes; oldest unfinished work and dispatcher lag both bounded to ten seconds
scope: 100 synthetic accounts / 500 native MLS clients / 50 ten-device groups / 500 authenticated WSS; encrypted fsynced native checkpoints, not browser IndexedDB or physical devices; fixture enrollment and login excluded

postgres_container_usage_before.scope: Owned container cgroup v2, includes every PostgreSQL child and container page cache; peak includes setup

postgres_container_usage_after.scope: Owned container cgroup v2, includes every PostgreSQL child and container page cache; peak includes setup

api_profile.scope: HTTP middleware SQL plus ASGI arrival/response; process-wide DB connection/commit/rollback timing includes WebSockets; no WebSocket cursor SQL, SQL text, parameters, paths, headers or identifiers; timings overlap, do not sum phases

tls_transport.scope: TLS records including HTTP/WSS headers and payloads; excludes TCP/IP overhead

postgres_durability: fsync=on; synchronous_commit=on; full_page_writes=on; checksums=on; disk-backed disposable Docker volume; timings enabled
limits: Unmodified ingress/DB/API rate/connection/storage limits; per-account loopback source; one API worker; co-located synthetic driver; no production or physical-device qualification
